_comment: Looks (0.9.0): route ink, marker frames and crest frames. Bought at the stall (its fifth offer each week) and kept as inventory_items rows whose ids carry their kind (ink:, marker:, crest:); the free ones (price 0) everyone has. The route line has always been terracotta, so Terracotta is the default ink and plain Ink is free to choose. Crest frames are also earned: each deed tier reached gives one (crest:<deed>-<tier>, inventory/deeds.py). `color` is the ink's line on the maps.
